description: Exotic / alternate package managers and user-tree installs under $HOME (and a few well-known system store roots as report-only). Covers Nix caches vs store, nix-darwin and home-manager user leftovers, MacPorts/pkgsrc/Fink distfiles and logs, Spack, Guix, conda/mamba/micromamba (envs report-only, pkgs cleanable), pixi/rattler deeper cache layout, EasyBuild, linuxbrew under home, asdf downloads, and mise cache/downloads. Prefer native GC (nix-collect-garbage, guix gc, port reclaim, spack clean, conda/mamba clean, brew cleanup) over blind rm for stores and profiles.

risk_policy.package_stores_install_trees: report-only (Nix /gnu store, Spack opt, linuxbrew Cellar, mise/asdf installs)
risk_policy.environments_profiles: report-only (conda/mamba/micromamba envs, nix/guix profiles, home-manager generations)

notes: Deepens coverage beyond macos-batch-03/09/10 for exotic PMs. $HOME-scoped where possible. /nix/store and /gnu/store listed report-only only for size inventory; never auto-delete. Config trees (.config/nix, .config/nix-darwin, .config/home-manager, .config/guix, ~/.spack/*.yaml) are not clean targets.

rules.name: Nix user evaluation and fetch caches
rules.description: Regenerable Nix client caches under XDG/Library cache (eval, tarball, fetcher, binary-cache indexes). Not the Nix store.
rules.notes: Safe to wipe; Nix rebuilds flake eval and fetch metadata. Does not free /nix/store. Prefer this over touching profiles.

rules.name: Nix store and user profiles (report-only)
rules.description: Nix store, user profile symlinks, and state dirs. Report size only; reclaim via nix GC tools.
rules.notes: Never rm /nix/store or profile links by hand. GC only removes unreferenced store paths. Keep channels/config intact.

rules.name: nix-darwin user leftovers
rules.description: User-visible nix-darwin activation leftovers under $HOME (Nix Apps folder, profile state). Not system /run or /etc managed files.
rules.notes: Do not delete ~/.config/nix-darwin or flake sources. System profile history needs sudo + nix tools. Nix Apps is a convenience folder of links into the store.

rules.name: home-manager generations and gcroots
rules.description: home-manager state, gcroots, and profile generations that pin Nix store paths.
rules.notes: Prefer home-manager expire-generations then nix GC. Never delete ~/.config/home-manager or active generation blindly. Old generations block store GC.

rules.name: MacPorts user distfiles, software archives, logs
rules.description: User-writable MacPorts distfiles, archived software, build work, and logs (home prefix installs).
rules.notes: Default system prefix is /opt/local (often root-owned; out of default $HOME clean). Prefer port reclaim for /opt/local.

rules.name: pkgsrc unprivileged distfiles and work
rules.description: pkgsrc bootstrap under home: distfiles, work objects, local package tree caches.
rules.notes: Unprivileged LOCALBASE often ~/pkg; DISTDIR/WRKOBJDIR may be under pkgsrc or pkg/usr. Do not wipe ~/pkg/bin or pkgdb without user intent (install tree).

rules.name: Fink user distfiles and caches
rules.description: Legacy Fink package manager caches when installed under the user home.
rules.notes: System Fink often uses /sw (privileged). Only user-tree paths listed.

rules.name: Spack source, stage, and misc caches
rules.description: Spack downloaded sources, build stage, and ~/.spack misc_cache indexes.
rules.notes: Default misc_cache is ~/.spack/cache; source_cache often $spack/var/spack/cache. Prefer spack clean. Do not delete ~/.spack/*.yaml config.

rules.name: Spack install tree (report-only)
rules.description: Spack installed package tree under user spack checkout.
rules.notes: Install prefixes are not disposable caches. Report size; uninstall via spack.

rules.name: Guix user checkout and client caches
rules.description: Guix ~/.cache/guix (channel checkouts and related client cache).
rules.notes: Checkouts cache can be multi-GB; regenerable. Does not free /gnu/store.

rules.name: Guix store and profiles (report-only)
rules.description: Guix store and user profile symlinks; GC via guix tools only.
rules.notes: Profiles are symlinks into /var/guix/profiles. Never rm store paths directly.

rules.name: Conda/mamba/micromamba environments (report-only)
rules.description: Named environments under common installer roots. Never auto-delete envs.
rules.notes: Envs hold user project stacks. Inventory only. Micromamba default root is ~/micromamba (MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX).

rules.name: Conda/mamba package download caches (pkgs)
rules.description: Tarball/extracted package caches shared by envs; cleanable and regenerable.
rules.notes: pkgs/ only, never envs/. Forces re-download of packages. Paths vary by installer location.

rules.name: Micromamba root pkgs cache
rules.description: Micromamba/Mamba root-prefix package cache ($root_prefix/pkgs).
rules.notes: Default MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX is ~/micromamba; pkgs is the shared download cache for all envs under that root.

rules.name: Pixi / rattler deep package cache
rules.description: prefix.dev pixi shared rattler cache including pkgs, repodata, uv-cache, and http-cache subdirs.
rules.notes: macOS default is ~/Library/Caches/rattler (override PIXI_CACHE_DIR / RATTLER_CACHE_DIR). Subdirs: pkgs, repodata, uv-cache, http-cache. Hard/reflinked into project .pixi/envs; deleting cache forces re-download but does not remove project envs.

rules.name: Pixi global home and tools (report-only)
rules.description: Global pixi install root (~/.pixi) including globally installed tools/envs.
rules.notes: Project-local .pixi/envs under repos is out of scope for global walk. Report ~/.pixi size; remove tools via pixi global.

rules.name: EasyBuild sources and build directories
rules.description: EasyBuild downloaded sources and temporary build trees under default prefix.
rules.notes: Default EASYBUILD_PREFIX is ~/.local/easybuild. sources/ and build/ are regenerable; software/ modules stay report-only.

rules.name: EasyBuild installed software (report-only)
rules.description: EasyBuild installpath with built modules and software.
rules.notes: Installed stacks; not disposable cache. Report only.

rules.name: Linuxbrew / Homebrew under $HOME
rules.description: Homebrew-on-Linux (or portable) prefix under ~/.linuxbrew: tmp/cache/var only as cleanable; Cellar report-only.
rules.notes: Standard macOS Homebrew uses /opt/homebrew or /usr/local and Library/Caches/Homebrew (covered elsewhere). This rule is only ~/.linuxbrew user-tree installs. Prefer brew cleanup.

rules.name: Linuxbrew prefix Cellar (report-only)
rules.description: Installed formulae under ~/.linuxbrew Cellar/opt.
rules.notes: Full prefix inventory. Do not bulk-delete Cellar.

rules.name: asdf plugin downloads and tmp
rules.description: asdf download staging and temp (not installed tool versions or plugins).
rules.notes: ASDF_DATA_DIR default ~/.asdf. downloads/ holds plugin-fetched archives before install. Never delete ~/.asdf/plugins or shims.

rules.name: asdf installed tool versions (report-only)
rules.description: asdf installs tree; report size only.
rules.notes: Only remove versions proven unused vs .tool-versions. Keep plugins/shims/config.

rules.name: mise cache and downloads
rules.description: mise (ex-rtx) internal cache and plugin download staging.
rules.notes: macOS cache default often ~/Library/Caches/mise; data dir ~/.local/share/mise. downloads/ are install staging tarballs; safe to clear.

rules.name: mise installed tool versions (report-only)
rules.description: mise tool installs under data dir; report only.
rules.notes: Never bulk-delete installs. Prefer mise prune for unused versions. Keep shims and config.

sources: Nix: ~/.cache/nix eval/tarball/fetcher caches; GC via nix-collect-garbage / nix store gc
nix-darwin: system profiles under /nix/var; user Nix Apps and XDG state leftovers
MacPorts: distfiles/software/logs under user prefix or Library/Caches/MacPorts
Spack: source_cache, stage, misc_cache ~/.spack/cache; spack clean
conda/mamba: envs report-only; pkgs cleanable; micromamba ~/micromamba/pkgs
mise: cache + downloads cleanable; installs report-only
